description: Moves the user's appointment to another free slot on the same day, atomically. Takes date (YYYY-MM-DD), from (HH:MM, the slot held now) and to (HH:MM, the new slot). Returns ok=true with moved_to, or ok=false with a reason: taken (the target slot was taken in the race — the user keeps the slot they already held, so either outcome leaves them with an appointment — that is the point of the atomic move), not_found, invalid, error. A move to a different day is a fresh booking and needs no atomic hold, so book is the right call for that. Authorization required: the one-time Telegram OAuth consent (scope booking:write), which also covers later calls.

date.description: Day of the appointment, YYYY-MM-DD. The move stays within this day.

from.description: Slot the user holds now, HH:MM.

to.description: Free slot to move to, HH:MM, same day, as returned by get_availability.

name: reschedule
